title: The water between us
label: SEAS & CONNECTIONS
description: A busy strait, two shores, a thousand islands. Follow the water that connects them.

stops.connection: Begin at a crossroads of world trade.
Across the strait, one federation stretches across two shores.
To the south, water connects an entire archipelago.
Now look west: another narrow passage connects whole regions.

title: Made in many places
label: WORK & THE WORLD
description: Look inside the things you use. Their stories cross more borders than their labels suggest.

stops.connection: Start with the parts and systems inside familiar products.
Follow the production networks across East Asia.
Look closer at another link inside your electronics.
Connections also carry services, not only physical goods.

title: The land shapes the story
label: NATURE & EVERYDAY LIFE
description: Rainforests, monsoon winds, and river corridors. See geography at work in everyday life.

stops.connection: Start with a forest that moves water through the atmosphere.
Across the ocean, seasonal rain organizes everyday life.
Follow a river system through a continental economy.
